stem:
Denise planted a flower garden with a rectangular section and a square section, as shown.

[Image of an L-shaped garden divided into squares, each representing 1 square foot]

What is the total area of the garden in square feet?
visual_elements: L-shaped garden diagram divided into 1 square foot units
difficulty_rationale: Requires counting or calculating the area of composite shapes, understanding area units, and summing areas.
